title: Gateway
description: A branch/merge point in a process flow (Core Model §03 Canvas, Phase B). exclusive = XOR (one outgoing path taken, chosen by the outgoing flows' conditions); parallel = AND (all outgoing paths taken). Structural only — it carries no guardrail; the tasks it routes to do.

id.description: Fully-qualified gateway id, e.g. CO.3.2.7.g1 — process apqc_code + '.g' + n.
